description: Known CVEs scanned in a vulnerable and a fixed version with CodeSentinel, CodeQL 2.27.6 (python-security-extended) and Semgrep CE 1.187.0 (the python/ rules of semgrep-rules at a5ad171, audit rules included). 'found' means an alert at the vulnerable sink with a correct source; an 'audit rule' alert flags the API wherever it is used, without a source; 'fixed_version' says whether the alert disappears after the fix.
